digest: Investigation of a single failed VPN login for m.alvarez followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login. Evidence indicates a user mistyped their password and then successfully authenticated from their registered device and usual home IP address. No malicious activity detected. AUDIT-CANARY-9F2A

evidence_findings.title: Failed VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: VPN authentication log shows 'vpn-auth-failure' for user 'm.alvarez' from IP '198.51.100.24'. Contextual notes indicate this occurred at 08:03Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: A single failed login attempt was recorded for user m.alvarez.

evidence_findings.title: Successful VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: VPN authentication log shows 'vpn-auth-success' for user 'm.alvarez' from IP '198.51.100.24', confirmed by MFA. Contextual notes indicate this occurred at 08:04Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The user m.alvarez successfully authenticated shortly after the failed attempt, using MFA from their registered device and usual home address.

evidence_findings.title: Contextual Information
evidence_findings.subject: VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.evidence: Notes associated with the authentication log state: 'Password mistyped once at 08:03Z; successful MFA-confirmed login at 08:04Z from the user's registered laptop and usual home address. No other failures for this account in the preceding 30 days.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The failed login was likely due to a user error (mistyped password), and the subsequent successful login was legitimate, originating from a trusted device and location.
